text:
marie: Heads-up: Beacon wants to bump to 50 seats. Procurement insists on a 6mo staged acceptance then auto-convert to 12mo. They need terms + signer path by EOD to secure SE enablement next week.
sam: What discount are they asking for during pilot?
marie: ~18-22% verbally. finance worried about conversion risk.
nina: Legal note: PO with delegated signer ok if there's Delegation of Authority doc. Otherwise require person on signature block.
legal-bot: Suggest one-page Delegation Addendum + Docusign for speed.
devin: Onboarding can deliver a trimmed enablement if we confirm now. SE slot is tight.
procurement-bot: Creating PO template with delegated-signer field, ETA 90m.
marie: Customer wants invoice split (50% pilot, 50% on convert). Finance prefers full upfront.
sam: Proposed compromise: 50% upfront + card on file for automatic charge on conversion. If conversion fails, prorate and issue credit.
nina: I'll draft the Delegation Addendum and run quick review.
marie: I'll send two options to buyer: (1) 6mo -20% pilot, 50% upfront, Delegation Addendum, hold SE week; (2) Annual convert now at list with full upfront and guaranteed SE.
devin: Flagging enablement prep checklist: 1) confirmSE dates 2) scope for condensed week 3) prework guide to reduce live hours.
procurement-bot: PO draft sent to marie@beacon.com. Included delegated-signer field + vendor code.
marie: Buyer replied: "Option 1 preferred, can you accelerate delegated signer doc? CFO out Mon-Tue."
nina: Will expedite and request temp delegated signature + follow-up wet-sign if bank insists.
marie: Thanks team. I'll update thread after signed. :thumbsup:
